decision_conditions: The development hereby approved shall be only used as an office, as defined by Class E of the permitted within Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) and no changes within Class E are permitted without the written approval of the Local Planning Authority.Reason:  In order for the local planning authority to have effective control and in the interests of residential amenity.
The office use shall not be changed to residential without the written permission of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To allow the Local Planning Authority to have effective control.

Access to the development shall only be permitted via Henderson Road, unless in the event of an emergency or for disabled access. Reason: In the interests of the residential amenity of those living on the upper floors.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, evidence of a successful Secured by Design (SbD) Commercial 2015 certification must be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall be not be occupied until the development is completed in accordance with the approved details.  The approved security arrangements shall be maintained thereafter to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of public safety.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no external windows or doors other than those indicated on the approved drawings shall be installed in the development hereby approved without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

No flues or mechanical plant shall be attached to the development hereby approved without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: In the interests of visual and residential amenity.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, details of a waste strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details before the development is occupied and maintained thereafter to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of the environment and to sure adequate measures are in place.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, details of cycle parking shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and maintained thereafter to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of promoting sustainable transport.

The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with 26th May 2023 (the date of the decision notice of planning application reference 23/00796/FUL) Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Section 73 applications cannot vary the original time limit).
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans:VAR401VAR402VAR.BP	Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
description: Variation of condition 02 and 05 of application 23/00796/FUL to allow minor alterations to the staircase, removal of flank and internal window together with addition of rooflight to first floor extension, solar panels to ground floor extension, fenestration and doors to facilitate the new access arrangements and amendments to wording of condition 5.
